Wood 2 League: Command 2 Relay Drones to harvest Pulsar energy and beam it back to your Mothership. If you omit LINK, drones automatically link toward your Mothership when within range!

 The Goal

Route more quantum energy from deep-space Pulsars to your Mothership than your opponent over 100 turns.

 Rules

The game takes place in a 1600×900 space sector containing two Motherships and 5 Pulsars:

  • Drone Movement (MOVE x y): A drone moves up to 120 units per turn toward (x, y).
  • Laser Relay Links (LINK targetId): Each drone can project one outgoing laser beam up to 480 units to either its Mothership (targetId = -1) or another friendly drone (targetId = droneId). Default bandwidth is 6 energy/turn.
  • Energy Harvesting & Flow: Any drone within 200 units of a Pulsar that has a valid relay path to its Mothership routes energy from that Pulsar to the Mothership, constrained by the minimum remaining bandwidth along its relay path. Pulsars regenerate 3 to 5 energy at the end of each turn.
Victory Conditions
  • You have routed more total energy to your Mothership than your opponent at the end of the game.
Defeat Conditions
  • You have routed less total energy to your Mothership than your opponent at the end of the game.
  • Your program does not respond within the allotted time or outputs an unrecognized command.

 Game Input & Output

Initialization Input

Line 1: 3 space-separated integers width, height and leagueLevel, the width and height of the space sector (1600×900) and the current league level (1, 2 or 3).

Line 2: 4 space-separated integers myBaseX, myBaseY, oppBaseX and oppBaseY, the coordinates of your Mothership and of your opponent's Mothership.

Input for One Game Turn

Line 1: an integer pulsarCount, the number of Pulsars in the sector.

Next pulsarCount lines: 4 space-separated integers pulsarId, px, py and energy, the unique identifier, coordinates, and currently stored energy of each Pulsar.

Next line: an integer droneCount, the total number of Relay Drones.

Next droneCount lines: 6 space-separated integers droneId, owner, x, y, linkTarget and cooldown:

  • droneId: unique identifier of the drone.
  • owner: 0 if you own this drone (your drones are always listed first), 1 if owned by your opponent.
  • x, y: current coordinates of the drone.
  • linkTarget: current relay target (-2 for none, -1 for Mothership, or a friendly droneId).
  • cooldown: always 0 in this league.
Output for One Game Turn

One line per owned drone (in the exact order they appear in the input), containing one of the following commands:

  • MOVE x y where x and y are integer target coordinates, optionally followed by LINK targetId where targetId is -1 for your Mothership or a friendly droneId

You may optionally append MSG text at the end of a line. Example: MOVE 500 450 LINK -1

Constraints
width = 1600, height = 900
pulsarCount = 5
4 ≤ droneCount ≤ 6
Response time for first turn ≤ 1000 ms
Response time for one turn ≤ 50 ms
Maximum number of turns: 100
